name: Satsuei ~Kakushidori~
source:
Main character is a musician who extends women singing ability. One day he receives a letter from a certain school's director who asks to teach four girls singing in two weeks with any means required. Protagonist agrees to these harsh conditions, but girls distrust him and sabotage lessons. To turn the tides he adheres to insulting methods.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位拓展女性歌唱能力的音乐家。有一天，他收到某学校校长的来信，要求不惜一切代价在两周内教四个女孩唱歌。主角同意了这些苛刻的条件，但女孩们不信任他并破坏课程。为了力挽狂澜，他采取了侮辱性的手段。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
